name: Tsurine
source: Tsurine is a Psychoatric Specialist suffering from amnesia. She's empathetic, rational, and puts people and empathy over rules and regulations despite her work. She audits dangerous individuals, keeps tabs on her friend's wellbeing, and tries her best to get down to the bottom of every issue put on her plate. She was born on the 8th of Abylis, lives in the Congenial Ward, and has a unique version of Locum Pink, as well as a few other medical anomalies.
